facts.fact: The document cites results of the 5th general population and housing census (RGPH-5) as showing 141,757 children aged 9-14 out of formal school; it gives no enumeration date, so the document's publication date is used.

The document cites the harmonised survey on household living conditions (EHCVM) 2021 as giving a 70.8% literacy rate for people aged 15 and over; no release date is given, so the document's publication date is used.
